historical_record.description: Built as Hancock Elementary School, later Gordon Lau Elementary School.
Identified by the 2019 updated North Beach survey as appearing eligible for local landmark or California Register / National Register status — recorded as Hancock Grammar School.
City College of San Francisco's Chinatown/North Beach campus leased this building as its main site, before consolidating into a planned new campus at Columbus and Washington.

The Hancock Grammar School, an 18-classroom school, steel-framed and fireproofed, faced in pressed brick and terra cotta, was taken over by the Board of Education; designed in the city's Bureau of Architecture, it was built by F. H. Born on a $89,519 general contract.
